meta.pooling: pooled over the six regimes se3, se11, wangchen2, wangchen2_a0.03, chua_I, chua_II; LE1 (attractor hidden only in the weak sense) is excluded and reported separately under le1_separate

regime_survival.description: survival (y = 1: not excited / hidden_stat) per regime and bin, with counts, clusters (models) and Wilson 95% intervals; LE1 listed as the weakly hidden control (not pooled)

interaction.note: LR test of regime-specific slopes against a common slope (df = regimes - 1), cluster-robust Wald test of equal slopes; per-regime slopes from the interaction model (ML with ridge 1e-6, model-based and CR1 SEs) and its Firth-penalized version (finite under separation)

esn_sweep.wald_note: Wald tests that include a separated regime (slope -> -inf) are not reliable; use the LR test, the Firth Wald test, or the tests without separated regimes

heuristic_check.note: p_B = median basin share of the reproduced model attractor per regime: ESN = share of the uniform census of the reservoir cube (census_cube), classes = share of the uniform census of Q (census_confusion); the heuristic predicts log-link slopes b_g = beta log(1 - p_B,g)

esn_sweep.model: log P(y) = b_g U + covariates + regime effects (log-binomial, P < 1 enforced)

wangchen2.separation: complete separation in U (all survivors below all excited)

esn_sweep.note_separated: a regime whose survivors all have smaller U than all excited pairs has b -> -inf (not reported); it still enters the likelihood-ratio test

classes.model: log P(y) = b_g U + covariates + regime effects (log-binomial, P < 1 enforced)
classes.note_separated: a regime whose survivors all have smaller U than all excited pairs has b -> -inf (not reported); it still enters the likelihood-ratio test

standardized.description: pooled survival per bin (six regimes): crude share with cluster-bootstrap 95% percentile intervals (models resampled with replacement within regime), Wilson intervals on rows and on the number of clusters (for bins where the bootstrap interval degenerates at 0 or 1), direct standardization to the overall regime mix of the reproduced pairs (regimes without data in a bin dropped and the weights renormalized; 'coverage' = total weight of regimes present; cell_k_n_by_regime shows the cells: a regime cell with n = 1 gets the full regime weight, so the direct estimate is unstable where cells are tiny), and model-based marginal standardization (logit with bin dummies, covariates and regime effects, no bin x regime interaction, averaged over all rows); excited_r_as_hidden = crude share counting the light/full-protocol label excited_r as hidden (item 6)

esn_sweep.model: logit P(y) ~ log(1+U) + set_H1 + log_N + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6)

esn_full_U.model: logit P(y) ~ log(1+U) + set_H1 + set_H0 + log_N + rho_0.6 + rho_1.2 + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6)

esn_full_U_in.model: logit P(y) ~ log(1+U_in) + set_H1 + set_H0 + log_N + rho_0.6 + rho_1.2 + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6)

classes.model: logit P(y) ~ log(1+U_in) + class_mlp2 + class_res + set_HE1 + set_E1 + log_width + regime fixed effects (no intercept; ridge 1e-6)

links.description: same rows, covariates and regime fixed effects as the main fits; only the link and the transform of U change. logit: P(survive); log: log P(survive) linear (log-binomial, fitted P < 1 enforced); cloglog_exc: log(-log P(survive)) = cloglog of P(excited) linear in U or log(1+U) (positive slope = more excitation). AIC comparable within a block (same rows). U >= 1 block adds cloglog on log U (exponent test c = 1).

test_exponent_eq_1.note: -log P(survive) proportional to U^c; independent equilibria with a common excitation probability give c = 1
-log P(survive) proportional to U^c; independent equilibria with a common excitation probability give c = 1
-log P(survive) proportional to U^c; independent equilibria with a common excitation probability give c = 1
-log P(survive) proportional to U^c; independent equilibria with a common excitation probability give c = 1

equilibrium_model.description: one row per (unstable equilibrium, reproduced hidden attractor) of stage-M models, six regimes; y = equilibrium excites the attractor at some radius (1e-6, 1e-4 or 1e-3); random intercept per model (both attractors of a Chua model share it); covariates inside_Q, copy, dim_u_2, dim_u_3, class_mlp2, class_res, set_HE1, set_E1, log_width and regime effects (no intercept)

random_intercept_model.method: maximum likelihood, adaptive Gauss-Hermite quadrature (15 nodes per model, centred at the modes), Newton steps with the analytic gradient and Hessian for nodes held at the current modes; SEs from that Hessian
random_intercept_model.icc_latent_note: sigma^2 / (sigma^2 + pi^2/3), within-model correlation of the latent logistic propensities

LR_sigma_eq_0.note: 50:50 mixture of chi2(0) and chi2(1) under the null

gee_exchangeable.note: response-scale exchangeable correlation of the excitation indicators of two unstable equilibria of the same model (moment estimate)

pair_consistency.mismatch_note: a reproduced pair can be excited from an equilibrium dropped as a Newton runaway (|x| > 1e3) or vice versa; such pairs are counted as observed

implied_vs_observed_survival_by_U_in.note: expected = sum over reproduced pairs of the implied probability that none of the pair's unstable equilibria (inside and outside Q) excites the attractor: random_intercept integrates the product over the model's random effect (60-node Gauss-Hermite); independent_logit uses the sigma = 0 fit; constant_p_geometric uses (1 - p)^U with p = raw share of exciting equilibria; z = (O - E)/sqrt(sum S(1-S)), which ignores parameter uncertainty and the sharing of a model by two Chua pairs

excited_r.description: label excited_r: the reproduced attractor is reached from an unstable equilibrium only at radius 1e-4 or 1e-3, not at 1e-6 (light protocol: esn_sweep, classes; full protocol: esn_full). survival_excited_r_as_hidden counts them with the survivors; bootstrap intervals of these shares are under standardized.*.excited_r_as_hidden_ci95_boot

penalty_calibration.description: expected survival of the penalized two-layer perceptrons (stage P, H = 256, sets H1/HE1, six regimes) from the empirical survival k/n of stage-M two-layer perceptrons in the same (regime, set, U_in bin) cell, no smoothing; a cell without stage-M rows is replaced by the pooled (set, bin) cell over regimes, then by the pooled bin. exact: O ~ Poisson-binomial(p) with the reference rates fixed; bootstrap: models of both stages resampled within (regime, set), reference rates recomputed; diff = (O - E)/n

U_in_0_comparison.note: reproduced pairs with U_in = 0; penalized = lam 0.1 and 1 pooled; one-sided tests of higher survival in the penalized models; exact stratified = conditional test over (regime, set) strata

data_intervention.description: stage V, six regimes, first hidden attractor of each network (HA / HA_a), as data_effects.json stage_V.first_hidden_attractor_only; network = reservoir (regime, N, rho, eta, seed), whose readout is trained on H1 or on H1 plus 5/10/20 transients (E5/E10/E20); analysis rows = attractor reproduced and index sum 1

mediation.description: exposure = data variant (E5, E10, E20 vs H1); mediator M = log(1+U); outcome = not excited (light protocol); confounders = regime and log N. Mediator model: OLS of M on variant + log N + regime (variant x regime in 'mediator_arm_x_regime', restricted to regimes with reproduced rows in all four arms); outcome model: logit of y on variant + M + log N + regime (+ variant x M in 'outcome_arm_x_log1pU'). Counterfactual P(a, M(a')) = mean over rows i and empirical mediator residuals j of expit(outcome model at variant a, M = predicted M_i(a') + resid_j) (parametric g-formula); TE = P(a, M(a)) - P(H1, M(H1)), NDE = P(a, M(H1)) - P(H1, M(H1)), NIE = P(a, M(a)) - P(a, M(H1)); log-odds versions logOR_*; logit-scale coefficients: c_total (model without M), c_direct (with M), indirect_product = alpha x beta_M, indirect_difference = c_total - c_direct (not equal under non-collapsibility). 95% percentile intervals from the cluster bootstrap (networks resampled within regime); boot_share_le_0 = share of replicates <= 0. Rows: analysis rows of H1, E5, E10, E20 (eqc excluded)

conditional_logit_within_network.description: strata = networks; only networks with both outcomes among their analysis rows contribute; regime and N are constant within a network

q_scale.description: U_in recomputed with the region Q scaled about its centre by s (inside if |x_k - c_k| <= s h_k in every coordinate, h = half-edges); s = 1 is the paper's U_in. Classes: stage-M raw records (runaways |x| > 1e3 dropped), reproduced pairs, six regimes, covariates as the classes fit; ESN full protocol: stage-C raw records, reproducing models, six regimes, covariates as the esn_full fit

match_thresholds.description: reproduced = delta_att < t and d_H < t (the paper uses t = 0.2); the hiddenness label is stored for every pair whose model attractor of the right kind was found (>= 8 of 64 starts on the true trajectory), so the split can be redone without new runs. Classes: classes_rows.csv (columns dA, dH, label); ESN size sweep: stage-N raw records (same selection as paper_esn_law.py), index sum 1; six regimes

esn_rho_labels.description: stage C ESN models (sets H1, HE1, H0), six regimes. U by spectral radius rho for all models (reproducing or not) and for reproducing models; stratified comparison within (regime, set, N, eta) strata and paired by seed (the same reservoir draw rescaled to another rho); full-protocol labels by U bin for the reproducing models

stratified_ols_log1pU.note: OLS with stratum fixed effects (regime x set x N x eta), HC1 SEs; coefficients are differences in mean log(1+U)

survival_rho_effect_given_U.note: [coef, se_model, se_robust] of the rho dummies (vs 0.9) in the esn_full logit with log(1+U)
